reviewed.title: 按NASM实际能力允许合法64位静态指针重定位
reviewed.description: NASM vendor 2.x supports reloc-abs-qword but compiler assembly warning guards use major>=3. Native semantic suite fails before executing on valid static Unicode.VERSION pointer dq. Extend existing warning capability probe to selectively permit supported absolute qword relocations, retain Wall/Werror and avoid unknown options; meaningful capability tests and actual native semantic rebuild prove it. No semantic failures may be counted as passing.

verification.summary: 定向复验通过，等待源码/契约审查
